nodes.title: A small drone an adult and a 10-year-old can build together, from a request by a 10-year-old
No soldering
Flown by sight, no camera or goggles, mostly indoors
Everything to buy costs no more than $150, including the radio, batteries and charger
Printed on my Snapmaker U1: a 270 mm cube, several materials at once

Low guard hoops instead of tall ducts
